description: Before you sign: send the exact unsigned bytes and your intent; tide dry-runs them on mainnet and returns a receipt signed by tide (ed25519) with the digest Sui will give them, every simulated balance change, object and event, what Sui itself enforces (Agent Pass caps, listed pools, price floor, budget), checks of your intent (max_spend, min_receive, nothing else leaves the wallet) and a verdict. Give your human the url. After sending, call confirm_execution. Example: { tx_bytes: "AAAC...", intent: { action: "swap", max_spend: { USDC: "5" }, min_receive: { SUI: "4.9" } } }.

intent.description: What you mean to do. Optional fields: action, pass (Agent Pass id), wallet, max_spend { coin: amount }, min_receive { coin: amount }, deadline_ms. Amounts in whole coins.

tx_bytes.description: Full unsigned TransactionData, base64 (sender, gas and budget set).

name: receipt_for_transaction
title: Signed receipt before signing
